name: go-design-patterns
description: > Idiomatic Go design patterns: functional options, builder, factory, strategy, middleware chain, pub/sub, and other patterns adapted for Go's type system. Use when: "design pattern", "functional options", "builder pattern", "factory pattern", "strategy pattern", "middleware chain", "option pattern", "how to structure this". Do NOT use for: interface design principles (use go-interface-design), package layout (use go-architecture-review), or concurrency patterns (use go-concurrency-review).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 一套符合 Go 语言习惯的设计模式指南，适合解决功能选项、构建器、工厂、策略及中间件链等代码结构问题。
